name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) clause is redundant – the other hard rules (Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) together with Existence(target_picked_up)) already force has_door_key before finishing, so the task does not need a separate RespondedExistence. Remove this clause to avoid an unnecessary added requirement.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause R1 RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is redundant. All finishing runs must already contain has_door_key (due to the hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up)), so the rule adds no extra requirement. Remove the RespondedExistence clause; the remaining Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and Existence(target_picked_up) correctly capture the task.

texts: If the ball is moved, the key must also be taken.
The key must be taken before the target box is picked up.
Eventually pick up the target box.
